title: Add Drift Review schema support
instructions: Implement Drift Review Slice B as deterministic schema and summarizer support only. Input must be a structured DriftReviewReport object, not raw reviewer text or uncited transcript parsing. Start with focused behavior tests in tests/drift-review.test.ts, then implement src/core/drift-review.ts. Define outcome and drift-category enums matching references/playbooks/drift-review.md, a structured evidence item shape, a single nextAction shape, validateDriftReviewReport(input: unknown), and summarizeDriftReviewReport(input: unknown). Keep summary output deterministic and always advice-only with reviewerAuthority "advice-only" and trustedStateChanges false. Tests must cover valid structured reports, invalid outcome/category, no_drift requiring category none, drift outcomes rejecting category none, missing or empty cited evidence, missing nextAction, multiple next actions via nextActions or array-shaped nextAction, and lifecycle-authorizing wording such as accept run, merge, cleanup, push, mutate lifecycle, or create task. Do not add CLI commands, resolver runtime behavior, raw text parsing, daemon/watch behavior, automatic transcript capture, task creation, lifecycle mutation, policy changes, task template changes, agent profile changes, package changes, hidden memory, or broad refactors.
